name: investment.holdings

list.description: Query native investment records in the declared scope.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Portfolio snapshot date (YYYY-MM-DD), independent of row valueDate.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Exact native currency; repeatable local selection.

parameters.name: product-code
parameters.description: Exact native product code; repeatable local selection.

get.description: Query native detail using orderId; response echoes orderId.

purpose: Inspect native investment business records through inquiry-only endpoints.
identity_description: List identity is native investmentNo; get sends it as orderId and validates the native orderId echo. There is no common response identity field across the two actions; the adapter enforces both native identities.
limitations: JSON POST /portfolioQueryList.json; fixed tenant GUAPW3SG; rowStart offsets of width 500; data.data and fixed data.totalCount.
Native fields, amounts, rates, nulls, unknown fields and response order are retained without conversion.
Refresh retains one nonempty acquisition. Empty or failed refresh preserves the previous snapshot; live never publishes.
Runtime/date-partition Duckdog import has no supported contract for this leaf; installation initializes an empty binding only.
Fixed status=[ACTIVE, INACTIVE]. date selects the complete portfolio snapshot, never a row valueDate filter. get sends investmentNo as orderId.
get uses form POST /queryIncrementOrderDetail.json, only orderId, and requires matching native orderId.
The manifest declares no shared response identity because native detail can omit investmentNo. No alias field is injected into native detail.
